title: Guided routing playbooks: template-driven region/tier fallback editor
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create a guided 'playbook' experience in the Console that lets customers pick from curated routing templates (region-first, cost-prioritized, latency-strict) and then customize tier routing and fallback model variants. The editor should provide inline validation, explain trade-offs (latency vs cost vs availability), and a scenario preview that simulates traffic across regions and tiers. Aim for an authoring flow that reduces setup time for common use cases while preserving advanced controls for power users.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select a template and see pre-filled region/tier/fallback rules
Inline validation surfaces incompatible fallbacks (e.g., quantized variant not available in selected region)
Preview simulator runs a 1-minute synthetic workload and reports per-region latency, estimated token cost, and failover counts
Saved policies appear in the customer policy list and can be toggled on/off without redeploying runtime
Telemetry: route decisions, fallback events, and preview runs are logged to the Console tracing dashboard
decisions: Expose 3 starter templates: region-first, balanced (latency+cost), and conservative-availability
Default template experience is opt-out for existing customers using legacy routing (backwards compatible)
Validation will be primarily client-side with a final server-side dry-run before saving to prevent latent incompatible configs
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff with Eng (Ethan Park) and Design (Lena Müller). Reviewed template matrix and telemetry needs.
2025-02-18: Proto wireframes delivered (Drive link) and initial UX patterns agreed: compact rule rows, context help toggles.
2025-02-26: Spike complete for server-side compatibility check (ENG-6124). Found missing model variant metadata in model catalog; added dependency.
2025-03-04: Engineering implemented in-console Linter; catches cross-region variant mismatches and label mismatches in routes.
2025-03-10: PM/Design review with beta customer (AcmeAI). Feedback: want clearer cost impact indicator and rollback button in preview.
2025-03-12: Incorporating feedback; added an explicit rollback control and cost delta tooltip in preview simulator.
risks: Complexity creep: too many template knobs will confuse users. Mitigation: surface advanced settings behind 'expert mode'
Model metadata lag: if model-catalog isn't up-to-date, validation may be inaccurate. Mitigation: add periodic sync and fallback warnings
Customer trust: incorrect preview estimates could erode confidence. Mitigation: label preview as estimate and show confidence bands
customer_notes: Requested scenario: routing user messages to US-West low-latency tier and EU for backup; fallback to smaller quantized variants only after region exhaustion
Beta customer (AcmeAI) prefers explicit cost delta shown for each fallback step
next_steps: Finalize UX copy for explainers and tooltips (DES-220)
Run internal canary with 5 customers and capture preview-run telemetry
Create rollback guide for support team and update runbook
